title: state: define ProgressiveDiscoverPhase enum
description: Define the ProgressiveDiscoverPhase enum with all 6 states for the Progressive Discover flow state machine

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL always have a valid current phase
THE SYSTEM SHALL provide Default impl returning Prompt phase

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user clicks Extract Fields button
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL transition from Prompt to Extracting phase
THE SYSTEM SHALL transition from Extracting to ConfirmingFields phase

unwanted.condition: IF invalid phase transition is attempted
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow skipping phases
unwanted.because: Skipping phases would bypass critical validation steps

postconditions: Display trait implemented for all variants
invariants: All variants implement Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize

happy: Display trait returns correct string for each variant
error: No invalid variants can be constructed
